title: Iowa men's golf to compete at Fallen Oak Collegiate Invitational in Biloxi
text:
← Back to the wire
Iowa men’s golf to compete at Fallen Oak Collegiate Invitational in Biloxi
The University of Iowa men’s golf team will wrap up its fall team schedule at the Fallen Oak Collegiate Invitational from Oct. 17-19 in Biloxi, Mississippi. The Hawkeyes face strong competition among a field featuring several nationally ranked programs.
The University of Iowa men’s golf team will close out the team portion of its fall schedule from Oct. 17-19 at the Fallen Oak Collegiate Invitational in Biloxi, Mississippi. The tournament is set to take place at the Fallen Oak Golf Course, a 7,487-yard par 72 course, with teams playing 54 holes over three days.
Fans can follow live scoring on Scoreboard.Clippd.com and receive updates through Iowa men’s golf social media channels. Iowa's lineup for this event includes fourth-year Maxwell Tjoa, third-year Grant Gudgel, third-year Jack McCarty, first-year Andrew Johannsen, and second-year Bennett Warren.
The invitational features a competitive field of 14 teams including six ranked in the top 20: Alabama (4), Arkansas (1), Florida State (67), Georgia (14), Illinois (12), Iowa (58), LSU (36), Mississippi State (34), Ohio State (20), Ole Miss (37), South Carolina (46), Southern Miss (57), Tennessee (9), Wake Forest (30), and Wisconsin (95). The host course was designed by Tom Fazio and has been recognized by Golf Digest as one of America’s top public courses. It is available exclusively to guests of Beau Rivage Resort and Casino.
Recent performances by Hawkeye golfers include leading after two rounds at the Inverness Intercollegiate before finishing tied for sixth place with an 872 total score. Bennett Warren achieved his best collegiate finish there, tying for 19th place with a six-over-par 219 that included a one-under-par second round. Maxwell Tjoa finished under par in all three rounds at the ANF Fall Classic, tying for fourth place overall.
Grant Gudgel recorded his top collegiate finish earlier this month at the Fighting Irish Classic in South Bend with a two-under-par total over three rounds. He currently leads Iowa with a scoring average of 71.22 across nine rounds this season and has posted two top-10 finishes so far.
Following this tournament, individual Hawkeyes will compete at the Zach Johnson Invitational on Oct. 19-20 in Des Moines to conclude their fall season.
